rows.text: walks the circular list whose sentinel is at `rcx + 8` (first node qword `+8`, next link qword `+0` of each node) and, at the first node whose qword `+0x10` object has dword `+0x50` equal to `edx` (or at the first node at all when `edx` is -1), tail-jumps to `00222B70` with that object in `rcx` and `edx`, `r8`, `r9` unchanged; returns without a call when the list is empty or no node matches
calls `003473A0 + 0x4` with the incoming registers unchanged, then `0037C910(0)`, then tail-jumps to `003473A0 + 0x19` with `ecx` = 1
calls `003614C0 + 0x12` with `rcx`, `edx` and `r8` unchanged, `r9d` = 0x7F and a fifth (stack) argument of 0, and returns its result
returns 1 when byte `02B5E111` is non-zero and 0 otherwise (a loop over 0x38-byte records bounded at one record)
